title: Data Export Approval Policy
text: Data export requires manager approval for confidential datasets. Public datasets may be exported without legal review when the data classification registry marks the dataset as public.

title: Data Export Approval Policy
text: Exports containing personal data require privacy counsel review and audit logging. The export owner must keep approval evidence with the request record.

title: Vendor Access Review Policy
text: Vendor access requires legal review before onboarding production tenants. Sandbox tenants may use a short-form review if access is read-only and expires within seven days.

title: Vendor Access Review Policy
text: All vendor access decisions require a source reference and owner approval. The owner must record the tenant, vendor, duration, and access mode.

title: Record Retention Policy
text: Customer support records are retained for two years unless a legal hold applies. Security audit records are retained for five years.

title: Record Retention Policy
text: Deletion requests must be reviewed against the active legal hold registry before removal. Legal hold status overrides the standard retention schedule.

title: Incident Notification Policy
text: Security incidents involving regulated customer data require notification review within 72 hours. The incident owner must preserve evidence for review.

title: Incident Notification Policy
text: Low-severity incidents without customer data are tracked internally and do not trigger external notice. Internal tracking still requires an incident owner.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Policy
text: Cross-border transfer of restricted customer data requires privacy counsel approval and a transfer impact assessment.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Policy
text: Transfers of anonymized operational metrics are permitted when no personal data or confidential business data is included.
